title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, gives many identical fresh chats guide-grade cognitive posture, lets them self-assign/chain/discover/verify/integrate/recover useful work under scoped authority, recursively increases useful durable progress with decreasing human coordination, and guarantees that a replacement /g inherits the predecessor's exact unfinished frontier instead of reconstructing it shallowly.
human_goal: The human can paste `/wc` into many fresh chats without numbering or routing them while workers organize distinct/complementary work and continue useful cycles. At the same time, `/g` must be a verified durable successor: it recovers predecessor unfinished work, reconciles newer evidence, distinguishes truth layers, preserves the real metabolism gap, and never makes the human reconstruct the old guide conversation. The human uses `.` for a durable guide execution cycle, not as a mandatory merger after every worker wave.
success_conditions: Fresh guide reincarnation without transcript or old-chat lookup.
Fresh guide runs GUIDE_SUCCESSION_PROTOCOL_V1 before its first current-state claim and loads unresolved GUIDE_SUCCESSOR_FIXLIST_V1 debt.
Fresh guide distinguishes CLOSED/CANDIDATE/VERIFIED/PROMOTED/CURRENT/SERVED/BLOCKED/UNPROVEN/HUMAN_DECISION and does not promote from plausible reconstruction.

Fresh guide preserves and tests the broader autonomy loop durable work -> live state consumption -> readiness/allocator -> wake/claim -> next useful work -> visible/local integration, separately from local Page Thread/S2 gates.
Fresh guide distinguishes no-human-courier from proven unattended continuation and repairs stale durable guidance when authority permits.
Any fresh /wc worker reconstructs the binding worker cognitive kernel and exact current durable state without human context transport.
A broad identical-worker wave spreads across distinct/complementary work rather than duplicating exclusive mutations.
One worker can continue through sequential same-context checkpoints and atomically claim a newly-unblocked successor without duplicate execution.
Prepared work exhaustion triggers deduplicated discovery/recovery before idle, without filler work.

Stalled attempts become suspect/recoverable under explicit time/evidence rules; recovery is append-only/CAS-safe and late returns remain evidence, while policy timing remains distinct from observed recovery latency.
Plan de acción/Universal Control, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital/Study Library and Alumnos/página docente each support local planner -> micro-swarm -> local steward loops.
Routine page integration does not require the global guide; only cross-root/shared-owner/high-authority conflicts escalate.
Executable Planner compiler generates N+1 from durable returns/dispositions and later N+2 through the same path without human task wording.
Context Fabric/Working Sets give each role enough strategic posture and exact evidence without unnecessary repository-wide rereading.
Fresh critics/validators remain independent from generators and can change/falsify routes.
Useful durable results per human intervention materially improves across generations; chat count alone is not success.
Parent can disappear mid-loop and a successor continues.
Live/Universal Control is a derived work/control surface, not a source of truth.
current_frontier: GEN2 closed-loop implementation remains preserved. In parallel, Universal Cognitive Worker /wc v3.1 is the active broad high-parallelism canary and the human is launching identical workers now; exact current work availability must be derived from live queues/claims/runs/returns/recovery/proposals rather than the original 52-READY publication count. In a third parallel corrective track, /g v1.3 + p.txt v4.9.2 + GUIDE_SUCCESSION_PROTOCOL_V1 now encode the previously-missed predecessor audit. That guide repair is ENCODED_AWAITING_FRESH_G_CANARY, not verified. The unresolved systemic verification remains durable work -> live state consumption -> readiness/allocator -> wake/claim -> next useful work -> visible/local integration. Local Page Thread/S2 evidence is a separate gate. /w remains evidence-gated.
next_human_action: Continue launching fresh chats with the exact same `/wc` bootstrap if useful capacity is desired. Do not number, route or transport results. No separate action is required for the guide repair while it is being persisted; a later genuinely fresh `/g` invocation will be the verification canary for succession behavior.
authority_law: Workers may think as broadly as the guide but may mutate only their claimed/authorized candidate scopes. Generated queues, local stewards, worker returns and critics do not self-promote Human Accepted, Current, Catalog, Lineage or Served authority. A guide successor likewise cannot infer current truth from recency, a plausible summary or its own confidence.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, roots/surfaces, generation inputs/outputs, queues/claims/runs/returns/recovery, local integration, verification, guide succession debt or frontier must be durable before relying on conversation memory.
